question: Can an observation-seeded simulator reproduce real galaxy observables before any candidate gravity law is tested?

scope.replica_mode: Observed 3.6 micron disk/bulge profiles and observed rotation curves are inputs. This tests scene generation and the virtual telescope, not gravity.
scope.blind_physics_mode: Observed rotation and lensing targets are forbidden inputs. A gravity law predicts them from the baryonic scene.
scope.important_limit: SPARC supplies radial photometry rather than resolved two-dimensional morphology here, so the replica is constrained to the observed axisymmetric radial light distribution, inclination, and rotation curve; bars, arms, and lopsidedness are not claimed to be reconstructed.
